purpose: Revise novelty claims after targeted primary-paper review; define bounded parallel experiments without changing pinned stage2 runtime.

assessment.current: Useful integration and experimental infrastructure; no demonstrated distinct method contribution or omni generalization yet.
assessment.H1_action_risk: Downgrade to baseline/control: frozen candidates, regional counterfactual utility and calibrated selective override have direct prior art in VetoNet.
assessment.H2_history_validity: Generic history gating overlaps LaverNet and TURTLE. Narrow the research hypothesis to explicitly supervised marginal restoration utility of an actual past observation for the current query.
not_claimed: pretrained component replacement or LoRA as a new algorithm
independent calibrated risk from current training-fit variance

primary_sources.overlap: Frozen restoration/generation experts, regional counterfactual swaps, relative utility, certified veto.
Selective restoration with disjoint policy tuning and risk certification; image iid assumptions do not establish video drift guarantees.
Lightweight all-in-one video restoration with selective propagation of degradation-agnostic features.
Causal history retrieval, alignment and routing.
Causal all-in-one restoration and per-frame degradation prompts.
Smoothly evolving compound weather and static/dynamic degradation prompts.

common_contract.launch: No training launched by this plan. New runtimes/run directories require CPU/NPU smoke, frozen contracts, healthy idle device, cooperative lock and second idle check. Do not modify or repeat healthy stage2 jobs.
common_contract.scope: R_phi structural pilots first; fixed H3 bridge remains a separately controlled path. LoRA follows a useful fixed candidate and matching training guides.
common_contract.data: Existing 32 train / 8 dev sources are pilot sources only. New mixed/temporal examples must be materialized with ordered degradation receipts. No approved independent calibration/test sources yet.
common_contract.fairness: Match source/crops, initialization, parameters, train samples/steps, history access and inference calls. Separately report teacher/label generation and tuning costs.
common_contract.temporal: Stride1 adjacent-frame evaluation plus 96-frame sequences; cross stable/abrupt/smooth degradation with motion/occlusion/cuts. A degradation change is not automatically a reason to reset history.
common_contract.selection: Use predeclared development gates; lock candidate and thresholds before untouched source-level test. Current 8 dev sources cannot certify novelty, generalization or risk guarantees.
metrics: source-paired per-task RGB PSNR and LPIPS
common_contract.negative_results: Keep null and harmful results. Do not expand steps to rescue a failed mechanistic control without a new stated hypothesis.

experiments.role: primary method hypothesis; novelty not established
experiments.question: Can supervision of each past observation's incremental restoration benefit improve temporal use beyond a same-capacity generic gate?
experiments.mechanism: For a fixed teacher, define local utility as loss without history j minus loss with history j. Predict it from current and past observed features; GT appears only in training labels. Positive utility encourages use, negative utility suppresses it.
experiments.removal_contract: Before labels are generated, specify and validate a missing-history mechanism. Train the shared teacher with that mask/dropout distribution; never treat arbitrary zeroed image pixels as an in-distribution observation. Freeze teacher and label hashes for all student arms; validate labels against actual intervention benefit.
experiments.student_validation: On source-disjoint development data, measure the trained student's own leave-one-history-out loss difference while holding all other history fixed. Evaluate predicted utility and harmful-history use against these student interventions, not merely against the teacher's self-generated labels. Student updates can change the true utility; teacher-label accuracy alone cannot pass the mechanism gate.
experiments.not_a_probability: Utility is restorer-dependent loss difference, not a calibrated probability or physical sensor reliability.
controls: same gate with restoration loss only
same gate with real marginal-utility supervision
same gate with utility labels shuffled within task/severity strata
fixed temporal decay and fixed hysteresis controls
experiments.screening_budget: Proposed first screen: three trainable arms, 1000 steps each, K3, crop96, same seed and minibatches. Precompute shared labels once and report that cost. Only a positive mechanism screen proceeds to repeated seeds and independent-source testing.
experiments.pass: Real utility beats the same-capacity and shuffled-label controls on paired transition quality and harmful-history use, while retaining stable-segment temporal benefit and clean protection.
reject: gain is confined to scene cuts
teacher labels fail to predict actual history intervention effects
experiments.integration_constraint: Current R_phi already reads raw K3 observations without generated feedback. Keep that property when integrating H3; do not present it as a newly fixed existing bug.
depends_on: stage2 full audit and frozen candidate

experiments.question: Does distinguishing ordered degradation interactions improve a single blind restoration pass at fixed capacity and compute?
experiments.paired_data: Start with C(N(x)) versus N(C(x)); hold source, noise draw, noise strength and codec settings fixed. Record clipping, color conversion, codec reset/GOP and temporal support. Additionally stratify by effective distortion so severity is not mistaken for order information.
experiments.mechanism: Represent order-dependent interaction in a compact condition code of one R_phi; no multi-expert tool chain. Do not assume optimal restoration order equals the reverse of the forward degradation order.
experiments.phase1: CPU source-paired synthesis and distortion/identifiability checks, followed by oracle-order, unordered-code and shuffled-order same-capacity controls (proposed 500 steps each). Oracle code is a labeled diagnostic only.
experiments.phase2: Only after phase1 shows headroom, learn a small observation-only order/interaction head and compare with the unordered blind model at the same budget. Test held-out parameter combinations, single-degradation and nearly commuting negative controls.
experiments.pass: Oracle order has useful headroom and blind inference recovers it beyond severity cues, parameter count and single-degradation specialization.
reject: oracle order does not improve restoration
shuffled or inverted codes leave performance unchanged
gain comes only from extra capacity
held-out severity combinations remove the gain
experiments.novelty_boundary: Order-aware restoration already exists. Potential contribution would be a proven identifiable and useful ordered interaction under a fixed video compute budget, not the presence of an order label.
depends_on: new ordered-pair dataset; current four single-task NPZs are insufficient

experiments.role: cheap feasibility diagnostic before designing a generation interface; not a standalone novelty claim
experiments.question: Does fixed H3 provide correct detail that is obscured by harmful changes in other components?
experiments.mechanism: Let R be R_phi and G the fixed H3 output. Decompose G-R into a predeclared orthogonal Haar or DCT partition; add selected bands back to R in pixel space. This is a representation intervention, not a known physical null-space projection.
controls: GT-oracle band subset for diagnosis only
experiments.budget: CPU reuse of pending fixed H3 all22-frame float32 caches; zero additional H3 sampling calls for the initial band screen, zero training.
experiments.measure: Evaluate final float32 output with identical clipping and report pre/post-clipping error, LPIPS and stride1 temporal changes. Oracle-selected subsets are never deployed or reported as learned-method results.
experiments.pass: A fixed representation constraint retains measurable correct detail beyond fixed mixing and random subspaces, without damaging stable structures or temporal consistency.
reject: even the tested oracle band family has no useful headroom
fixed mixing or random subspaces match the result
experiments.next_if_positive: Design and train a guide-matched residual interface/LoRA for the useful component; compare against ordinary matched-guide LoRA with equal budget.
depends_on: fixed raw-guide/R_phi-guide float32 output cache; presently not available
clean/near-clean H3 control implementation before protection claims

action_risk_control.fairness: Match accepted region coverage AND actual modification magnitude. Lower harm achieved simply by weaker editing is not evidence for a better risk estimate.
action_risk_control.calibration: Use separately audited source groups for threshold fitting and testing. Training-fit confidence and temporally correlated frames do not establish independent risk certification.
